products.product: TR130RL Radialite Rear Sprocket (KTM Husqvarna Gas Gas)
variants: TR130RL = 520 pitch, 38-56T (every tooth count 38 to 56 listed)
TR130RL = colour options Black, Blue, Gold, Green, Mag, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, Silver, Titan
products.what_it_changes: Aluminium 'Radialite' rear sprocket (lightweight alloy). Changing the rear tooth count changes final-drive gearing: more rear teeth = shorter gearing (harder pull, lower top speed per gear); fewer = taller gearing. Talon's product pages carry only a spec table (pitch, teeth, colours, fitment) and no further description.
products.supporting_parts: 520-pitch chain and a matching countershaft (front) sprocket; replace chain and both sprockets together. Talon lists matching Groovelite/standard front sprockets (see TG entries). Sprocket bolts sold separately (Talon 'Sprocket Bolts' category).
products.caveats: Talon's list stops at 2021 for every KTM-group model; 2022+ KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas use the same rear sprocket pattern in practice but Talon does not list them, so they are not included. The list omits Husqvarna FC 250/350/450, KTM XC/XC-F/XC-W and Husqvarna FX/TX even though Talon's TG328 front-sprocket page (same bike group) lists them - treat as an incomplete fitment table. GasGas 'MC 450F (2020)' is listed but falls before the roster years. Prices not recorded.
